derivation: src/lib.rs retains the supplied nom grammar, validator and formatter. Its encoder validation path is factored to return both canonical text and the already-parsed canonical Message; admit_message exposes that result without an additional encode/parse round trip. main.rs retains upstream parse/encode behavior and adds bounded persistent NDJSON serve, Linux parent-death cleanup and admit operations. Cargo manifest adds direct serde dependency for strict control request deserialization; dependency versions remain pinned.
transaction_derivation: ../lab_admission.py derives the mailbox send transaction from the supplied runtime/mas_protocol/store.py under the retained MIT license. It consumes the canonical typed result returned by Rust admission without repeating protocol encode/parse; mailbox SQL and run/actor/budget/deduplication checks retain their supplied meaning.
